name: school-management-workspace
description: Orchestrates local setup and concurrent dev servers for school-management-backend and school-management-frontend. Not a monorepo — each sub-repo keeps its own independent git history.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
